title: Source-aware application documentation and code navigation
summary: Created maintainable context-generation tooling for a large Angular engineering application.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2025-09-26. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Introduced reproducible GUI documentation collection and rendering, curated narrative overrides, source indexing, task-to-code navigation and reusable engineering guidance.
Built a source-aware GUI documentation pipeline using TypeScript metadata collection, Python rendering, curated narrative overrides and navigation/source indexes.
The inspected documentation guard returns no findings; surrounding orchestration scaffolding does not establish fully enforced automated documentation parity.

notes: The inspected documentation collector and renderer were attributed to Michael in the supplied analysis.
Surrounding orchestration included scaffolding; an inspected documentation-parity helper returned an empty result. Do not present the whole framework as fully enforced autonomous orchestration.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
